slug: 2025-02-27 Liberia struggles to enforce privacy and data protection laws

facts.fact: Africa-China Reporting Project states that Liberia has no dedicated data protection law, as confirmed by Assistant Postal Affairs Minister Melvin Yealue; the government is drafting a policy to implement the ECOWAS Data Protection Act.
Africa-China Reporting Project states that Liberia has no national data protection authority and no designated data protection officers, per Assistant Postal Affairs Minister Melvin Yealue.

systems.system: Policy to implement the ECOWAS Data Protection Act
systems.owner: Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications with the LTA
